match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Scarlett tears open the coral lipstick carton while ignoring the vibrating phone. Framing: medium close-up, over-the-shoulder, Scarlett fills the right third, with the black stone sink and vibrating phone in the foreground and hard morning light cutting across white tile behind her. Placement only, not the pose: Scarlett stands at the sink in a black turtleneck, holding a sealed coral lipstick carton in one hand while her phone rests beside the faucet. Camera, as one or two arrows: push-in, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Female, 20s, A sharp-eyed young woman of medium height, A sleek black turtleneck with a streamlined black-and-neutral. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
